title: How the Intune migration workflow moves through Clay
subtitle: Each row is a table. Follow the numbers left to right. Paid steps only run on rows that passed every step before them. Nothing is sent until legal, partner and facts sign-off.

lanes.name: People
lanes.note:
one row per contact.
The main table.

steps.title: Never contact
steps.text: Customers, partners, agencies, open deals (by domain)

steps.title: Pull Intune job posts
steps.text: TheirStack API: 'intune', last 30 days, GB FR US CA CH

steps.title: Read each post
steps.text: Regex: migration to Intune? not iOS-only? old EMM? file shares?

steps.title: Send each company once
steps.text: Deduped on domain, with the post's signals

steps.title: Enrich and gate company
steps.text: 250+ staff, HQ market, industry, not agency, not excluded

steps.title: Find new joiners
steps.text: EUC, mobility, endpoint titles; joined in the last 6 months

steps.title: Check the person
steps.text: Title and date gates, 2 per company, no internal move

steps.title: Route to a cell
steps.text: Old EMM = cell A to E. Ready to Contact?

steps.title: Email and copy
steps.text: Verified email (not Canada), copy lines, paused sequencer
